description: AI news digest Sep 20: Step 5 600B MoE API, Plugin4Shell agent RCE, Anthropic embedded evals and $100B pace, Grok transcribe, Siri AI, CXMT G5 memory.
lead: Agents under attack, agents under audit, and cheaper intelligence on every front. A 600B mixture-of-experts lands at a seventh of flagship pricing, a supply-chain flaw forces patches across four coding agents, Anthropic pairs a $100B revenue pace with embedded evaluators inside its own labs, and Apple redraws Siri around on-device models plus private cloud. Add a sharper speech API and a denser memory platform, and builders get a full stack of things to try and things to patch. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 20, 2026: agents patched, agents audited, cheaper models
